Pumpkin Maple Vinaigrette 

Ingredients
•  ½ cup pumpkin puree
•  ½ cup olive oil
•  ¼ cup apple cider vinegar
•  3 tablespoons maple syrup
•  1 tablespoon grainy mustard
•  1 teaspoon thyme
•  1–2 teaspoons chili pepper flakes
•  1–2 teaspoons salt and pepper
Wisk pumpkin puree, oil and vinegar, maple syrup, mustard, thyme, chili flakes, salt, and pepper until smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning; thin with a splash of water if needed.
